description.fun: Seedot hangs from branches by the stem on its head, drinking in moisture and nutrients until it's too heavy and drops off, and the more it drinks, the glossier it gets. It polishes itself with leaves once a day. Keeping still, it passes for an ordinary nut, then startles others by suddenly moving, and it even tricks bird Pokémon into carrying it off to new places.
description.guide: A small Grass-type Pokémon resembling an acorn that hangs from tree branches to absorb nutrients. It can be mistaken for a nut when it keeps still. It evolves into Nuzleaf at level 14, which evolves into Shiftry with a Leaf Stone.
description.tagline: An acorn that polishes itself daily and hitches rides with birds

description.fun: Nuzleaf plays the leaf on its head like a flute, sometimes with unsettling tunes that make people uneasy and sometimes with soothing ones. It's an expert climber that comes out of the forest to frighten people, but grab its long nose and it loses all its strength. It's modelled on the tengu, long-nosed forest spirits of Japanese folklore, with a dash of Pinocchio.
description.guide: A Grass- and Dark-type Pokémon, the middle stage of the Seedot line, based on the tengu of Japanese folklore. It plays music on the leaf on its head and likes to frighten people. It evolves into Shiftry when exposed to a Leaf Stone.
description.tagline: A long-nosed forest trickster who plays a leaf flute

description.fun: Shiftry lives atop ancient trees deep in the forest and is feared as its guardian: it arrives with freezing winds that are said to bring winter, whipped up by the leaf fans on its hands. It can read an opponent's mind and act first. Folklore says it was once a wicked bird Pokémon whose wings and beak were taken away as punishment.
description.guide: A Grass- and Dark-type Pokémon, the final form of Seedot, based on the tengu of Japanese folklore, with a white mane and leaf fans for hands. It lives in old trees and stirs up powerful winds. It evolves from Nuzleaf with a Leaf Stone.
description.tagline: A tengu-like forest guardian whose leaf fans call up winter
